tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Full details for one program by slug: summary, key facts, minimum investment, processing time, and the page URL in each published language.

tools.name: open_consultation
tools.description: Open the Passportivity consultation page in the current tab so the user can request advice. Opens the page only — it never fills or submits the form on the user's behalf.

programSlug.description: Optional program slug — opens that program page, whose form is scoped to it

tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Search the citizenship-by-investment and residence-by-investment programs Passportivity advises on. Returns name, country, minimum investment, processing time and the page URL for each match.

query.description: Free-text match over name, country and summary
